> *Standard form numbers are always written in the form*

$a\times10^{n}$

> *Where *$1\leqa<10$* and *$n$* is how many times the number has been multiplied by 10. *

> *For the number 15 060, *$a=1.506$* and this means that *$n=4$* because we would need to multiply by 10 4 times. *

> *Writing this in standard form we have*

$1.506\times10^{4}$ **[1]**
